story_text: As a user, I want to filter tasks by priority so that I can work on the most urgent items first.

positive.title: Filter tasks by each valid priority level
positive.expected_result: 200 OK · only tasks matching that priority returned

positive.title: Filter tasks by priority with no matching results
steps: 1. Set priority filter to a value that does not exist in any task (e.g., 'Urgent')

negative.title: Filter tasks by an invalid priority value
steps: 1. Set priority filter to an invalid value (e.g., 'Invalid')
negative.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · message lists valid priorities400 Bad Request · message lists valid priority values

negative.title: Filter tasks by priority using a numeric value instead of a string
steps: 1. Set priority filter to a numeric value (e.g., 1)

edge.title: Filter tasks by priority combined with category filter
edge.expected_result: 200 OK · only tasks matching both criteria returned
